subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt: The total area of a township is $68.4$ square miles, of which $9.7$ square miles is designated parkland. If the township had a population of $452,000$ people in the year $2015$, which of the following is closest to the population density, in people per square mile of non-parkland area, of the township at that time?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The non-parkland area of the township is found by subtracting the parkland area from the total area: $68.4 - 9.7 = 58.7$ square miles. The population density is the population divided by the non-parkland area, or $\frac{452{,}000}{58.7} \approx 7{,}700$ people per square mile.
